_comment: TEMPLATE. Copy to config.local.json and fill in. config.local.json is gitignored and never committed. Skills read it instead of hardcoding organization names.
_comment_tracker: Issue tracker for create-ticket, implement-ticket, solve-ticket: linear or jira. An adapter must exist in skills/tracker/.

jira._comment: Leave host empty if you do not use Jira. board and defaultTeam are optional; some projects require a team custom field on create.

linear._comment: workspace is the slug in https://linear.app/<workspace>. team is the issue key prefix.

repos._comment: root is the parent directory holding your service checkouts. Skills grep these read-only for prior art.

internal._comment: Used to identify first-party dependencies, which are exempt from cooldown and pinning rules. Match by URL, never by package name.

gcp._comment: Maps a service alias to its Kubernetes namespace and containers, and each environment to its GCP project. get-gcloud-logs reads this.

services._comment: Optional: environments, with the same shape as gcp.environments, for a service that runs in other projects.

gcp._comment_containers: containers = application deployments; jobContainers = scheduled or batch work: CronJobs, or a worker that runs scheduled tasks (also application logs); both go in the log filter. helperContainers never go in the filter. envOnly lists containers that exist only in some envs.

snowflake._comment: Maps each database to the topical keywords that route a question to it. query-snowflake reads this.

obsidian._comment: flowsDir is the vault folder where /document-flow writes pages.
